描述_EN: grave goods included models of domestic animals as well as beasts from the mythical world, such as this single-horned beast. mythical animals were placed inside tombs to ward off evil spirits. in the tang dynasty (618-907) objects for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 墓葬用品包括家畜和神话世界中的野兽模型，如这个单角兽。 神话中的动物被放置在墓穴中以避开恶灵。 在唐代（618-907），随葬品是用陶器制作的。
